response.sql: WITH telescope_averages AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(pulsepersec) AS avg_pulse_rate FROM signals GROUP BY telescref), first_baseline AS (SELECT AVG(pulsepersec) AS rate FROM signals), kept AS (SELECT t.avg_pulse_rate, b.rate AS first_rate FROM telescope_averages AS t CROSS JOIN first_baseline AS b WHERE t.avg_pulse_rate > b.rate), second_baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS rate FROM kept) SELECT AVG(k.avg_pulse_rate) AS mean_pulse_rate, AVG(k.avg_pulse_rate - k.first_rate) AS mean_above_first_baseline, AVG(k.avg_pulse_rate - s.rate) AS mean_above_second_baseline FROM kept AS k CROSS JOIN second_baseline AS s WHERE k.avg_pulse_rate > s.rate;
